cases.rule: a UID-stable rename is one modified semantic fact
new capability, effect, and error facts are marked high risk
source carrier and declaration order changes do not create semantic changes
stale result authority cannot be reviewed
derived output drift cannot be silently accepted
omitted facts remain detectable after synchronized resigning
approve binds current review authority without graph writes
reject binds current review authority without graph writes
a decision cannot be replayed against another review
